chunks: Then it will be said: 'This is what you had denied.'
ai.seo_question: What is said to the disbelievers when they are confronted with the reality of the resurrection?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the irony of the disbelievers facing the very reality they dismissed as falsehood, emphasizing the transition from denial to undeniable witness. It underscores the concept of *Haqq al-Yaqin* (certainty of truth), where the abstract promise becomes concrete experience, serving as a final rebuke to those who mocked the resurrection. This moment is often cited to illustrate the justice of God, where the punishment fits the specific nature of the denial.
